title: Condense Home next-queue TV labels
summary: Update the Home next-queue list to present TV rows as show name plus a compact season/episode label, while leaving movie labels unchanged.
reason: The Home next-queue panel currently lets TV episode titles dominate the row label, which makes the operator scan episode names instead of the series and season/episode position.
behavior_before: TV queue rows rendered the normalized display name or source filename as one title string, including episode titles such as 'Spring Prayer' or release filename tails.
behavior_after: TV queue rows render a show/series label with a small season/episode marker and omit the episode title from the main Home next-queue row label. Movie rows keep the existing movie-title display.
